Definition: properly, containing, i.e. a tube; also a bed or valley of a stream; also a strong thing or a hero
KeyPassages: Ezekiel 6:3; Joel 1:20; Song of Solomon 5:12; 2 Samuel 22:16
BiblicalUsage: Channels, valleys, beds of streams — the rivers of water running in the valleys, the beasts crying for the water brooks, the eyes of the beloved like doves by the rivers of waters, and the channels of the sea laid bare at the rebuke of the Lord. The word is the hollow the water runs in, and it can be full or dry.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the channels show me how God's blessing flows: it runs in low places, like water in a valley, and the beasts of the field know to cry for it when it is dry. I hold that my own dry places are where his water is meant to run.
RelatedBooks: 2 Samuel; Ezekiel; Joel; Song of Solomon
